title: How a Godly Man Acts When the Room Empties Out and No One's Grading Him
caption:
Every man has a church version, a group-chat version, and the version nobody else sees.

Only one of those is who you actually are. The others are just management.

God isn't grading the performance. He's already seen the version you hide.

#faith #integrity #christianmen #authenticity #manofgod
